items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I must have had about an eight-piece band. Skinny Brown was on tenor sax.

ctx.x: Oh, I've forgotten that little boy's name, he was kind of a young kid, I've forgotten his name now. He was Eli Robinson's cousin. And Step was the second trumpet player. In other words, we had three brass and two, two, I must have had about an eight-piece band. Skinny Brown was on tenor sax. He was one of the Savoy Sultans. You remember that old Savoy Sultan, he had played with Pat Jenkins.
They had a good swinging band. But he was a tenor player and Len Davis was the alto player and me and Step and Dickie Harris .....
